-- Relational evaluation preserves input encounter order through every operator.
import Json (..)
import Model (..)
import Binder (tree_any)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, length, sum)

pub fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

fn isnull(v : Json) : Bool =
  match v of
    JNull => true
    _ => false
fn truth3(v : Json) : Int =
  match v of
    JBool(true) => 1
    JBool(false) => 0
    _ => -1
fn bool3(n : Int) : Json = if n < 0 then JNull else JBool(n == 1)
fn cmp3(a : Json, b : Json, op : String) : Json =
  if isnull(a) || isnull(b) then JNull else
    let c = compare_value(a, b)
    JBool(if op == "=" then c == 0 elif op == "<>" then c /= 0 elif op == "<" then c < 0 elif op == ">" then c > 0 elif op == "<=" then c <= 0 else c >= 0)

pub fn evaluate(e : Expr, row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  let op = e.op
  if op == "lit" then
    e.value
  elif op == "col" then
    at(row, e.index)
  elif agg(op) then
    if op == "COUNT" then
      if length(e.args) == 0 then JInt(length(group))
      else JInt(length(filter(\(r) -> not(isnull(evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []))), group)))
    else
      let vs = map(\(r) -> evaluate(at(e.args, 0), r, []), group)
      if op == "SUM" then
        let ns = filter(\(v) -> not(isnull(v)), vs)
        if length(ns) == 0 then JNull else JInt(sum(map(integer, ns)))
      else
        extremum(vs, op == "MIN")
  else
    let a = evaluate(at(e.args, 0), row, group)
    if op == "NOT" then
      if isnull(a) then JNull else JBool(not(truth(a)))
    elif op == "ISNULL" then JBool(isnull(a))
    elif op == "ISNOTNULL" then JBool(not(isnull(a)))
    elif op == "COALESCE" then coalesce(e.args, row, group)
    else
      let b = evaluate(at(e.args, 1), row, group)
      if op == "+" then
        if isnull(a) || isnull(b) then JNull else JInt(integer(a) + integer(b))
      elif op == "-" then
        if isnull(a) || isnull(b) then JNull else JInt(integer(a) - integer(b))
      elif op == "*" then
        if isnull(a) || isnull(b) then JNull else JInt(integer(a) * integer(b))
      elif op == "AND" then
        bool3(if truth3(a) == 0 || truth3(b) == 0 then 0 elif truth3(a) == 1 && truth3(b) == 1 then 1 else -1)
      elif op == "OR" then
        bool3(if truth3(a) == 1 || truth3(b) == 1 then 1 elif truth3(a) == 0 && truth3(b) == 0 then 0 else -1)
      else
        cmp3(a, b, op)

fn coalesce(es : List(Expr), row : List(Json), group : List(List(Json))) : Json =
  match es of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(e, rest) => let v = evaluate(e, row, group) in if isnull(v) then coalesce(rest, row, group) else v

fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(JNull, rest) => extremum(rest, minimum)
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if isnull(b) || (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

pub fn fold_constants(e : Expr) : Expr =
  let n = Expr { ..e, args = map(fold_constants, e.args) }
  if (not(agg(n.op))
      && not(elem(n.op, ["lit", "col"]))
      && all(\(a) -> a.op == "lit", n.args)) then
    literal(evaluate(n, [], []))
  else
    n

fn conjuncts(e : Expr) : List(Expr) =
  if e.op == "AND" then
    append(conjuncts(at(e.args, 0)), conjuncts(at(e.args, 1)))
  else
    [e]

fn sources(e : Expr) : List(Int) =
  if e.op == "col" then
    [e.source]
  else
    flatten(map(sources, e.args))

fn combine(es : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  match es of
    Nil => literal(JBool(true))
    Cons(e, Nil) => e
    Cons(e, rest) => Expr { ..node("AND", [e, combine(rest)]), kind = "bool" }

-- Push a conjunct only when every referenced slot belongs to one inner-join
-- input. Slot numbers remain global; scan predicates receive a prefix padding.
pub fn optimize(plan : Plan) : Plan =
  let q = plan.query
  let terms = conjuncts(fold_constants(q.predicate))
  let pushable = \(e) -> let ss = sources(e) in length(plan.tables) > 1 && length(ss) > 0 && all(\(s) -> s == at(ss, 0), ss)
  let safe = \(e) -> pushable(e) && (at(sources(e), 0) == 0 || not(at(q.left_joins, at(sources(e), 0) - 1)))
  let fs = map(
      \(i) -> filter(\(e) -> safe(e) && at(sources(e), 0) == i, terms),
      range(0, length(plan.tables)),
    )
  let rem = filter(\(e) -> not(safe(e)), terms)
  let bq = Query {
    ..q,
    predicate = combine(rem),
    select = map(\(s) -> (fold_constants(fst(s)), snd(s)), q.select),
    joins = map(fold_constants, q.joins),
    having = fold_constants(q.having)
  }
  Plan { ..plan, query = bq, filters = fs }

fn join_rows(
  left : List(List(Json)),
  right : List(List(Json)),
  on : Expr,
  left_join : Bool,
  right_width : Int
) : List(List(Json)) =
  flatten(map(\(l) ->
    let hits = filter(\(r) -> truth3(evaluate(on, append(l, r), [])) == 1, right)
    in if length(hits) > 0 then map(\(r) -> append(l, r), hits)
       elif left_join then [append(l, replicate(right_width, JNull))] else [], left))

pub type Group = Group { key: String, rows: List(List(Json)) }

fn add_group(gs : List(Group), key : String, row : List(Json)) : List(Group) =
  match gs of
    Nil => [Group { key = key, rows = [row] }]
    Cons(g, rest) =>
      if g.key == key then
        Cons(Group { ..g, rows = append(g.rows, [row]) }, rest)
      else
        Cons(g, add_group(rest, key, row))

fn groups_for(rows : List(List(Json)), keys : List(Expr)) : List(Group) =
  var gs := []
  for row in sof(rows) do
    let key = encode(JArr(map(\(e) -> evaluate(e, row, []), keys)))
    gs := add_group(gs, key, row)
  if length(keys) == 0 && length(rows) == 0 then
    [Group { key = "[]", rows = [] }]
  else
    gs

fn project(
  q : Query,
  row : List(Json),
  group : List(List(Json))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  if truth(evaluate(q.having, row, group)) then
    [map(\(s) -> evaluate(fst(s), row, group), q.select)]
  else
    []

fn distinct_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  seen : List(String)
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) =>
      let key = encode(JArr(r))
      if elem(key, seen) then
        distinct_rows(rest, seen)
      else
        Cons(r, distinct_rows(rest, Cons(key, seen)))

fn row_compare(
  a : List(Json),
  b : List(Json),
  order : List((Int, Int))
) : Int =
  match order of
    Nil => 0
    Cons((i, code), rest) =>
      let desc = code >= 2
      let nulls = if code % 2 == 0 then 0 else 1
      let av = at(a, i)
      let bv = at(b, i)
      let either_null = isnull(av) || isnull(bv)
      let c = if isnull(av) && isnull(bv) then 0 elif isnull(av) then (if nulls == 0 then -1 else 1) elif isnull(bv) then (if nulls == 0 then 1 else -1) else compare_value(av, bv)
      if c == 0 then
        row_compare(a, b, rest)
      elif desc && not(either_null) then
        -c
      else
        c

fn insert_row(
  r : List(Json),
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Int))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => [r]
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      if row_compare(r, x, order) <= 0 then
        Cons(r, rows)
      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

fn sort_rows(
  rows : List(List(Json)),
  order : List((Int, Int))
) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of
    Nil => []
    Cons(r, rest) => insert_row(r, sort_rows(rest, order), order)

pub fn execute(plan : Plan) : Json =
  let q = plan.query
  var scans := []
  var offset := 0
  for i in srange(0, length(plan.tables)) do
    let t = at(plan.tables, i)
    let padding = replicate(offset, JNull)
    let predicates = at(plan.filters, i)
    let rs = filter(
        \(r) -> all(\(p) -> truth(evaluate(p, append(padding, r), [])), predicates),
        t.rows,
      )
    scans := append(scans, [rs])
    offset += length(t.columns)
  var rows := at(scans, 0)
  for i in srange(0, length(q.joins)) do
    rows := join_rows(rows, at(scans, i + 1), at(q.joins, i), at(q.left_joins, i), length(at(plan.tables, i + 1).columns))
  let filtered = filter(\(r) -> truth(evaluate(q.predicate, r, [])), rows)
  let projected =
    if plan.aggregate then
      flatten(
          map(
              \(g) -> project(q, if length(g.rows) > 0 then at(g.rows, 0) else [], g.rows),
              groups_for(filtered, q.groups),
            ),
        )
    else
      flatten(map(\(r) -> project(q, r, []), filtered))
  let distinct =
    if q.distinct then
      distinct_rows(projected, [])
    else
      projected
  let sorted =
    if length(plan.order) > 0 then
      sort_rows(distinct, plan.order)
    else
      distinct
  let skipped = drop(q.offset, sorted)
  let final =
    if q.limit >= 0 then
      take(q.limit, skipped)
    else
      skipped
  JObj([
      ("columns", JArr(map(\(s) -> JStr(snd(s)), q.select))),
      ("rows", JArr(map(JArr, final))),
    ])

-- Typed syntax and bound logical plan. JSON is used only for wire values.
import Json (..)
import Data.String (..)
import Data.List (..)
import Data.Foldable (all, any, length)

pub effect Domain
  never reject(String) : Unit

pub fn demand(b : Bool, code : String) : Unit =
  if not(b) then
    reject(code)

pub fn arr(j : Json) : List(Json) =
  match j of
    JArr(xs) => xs
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      []

pub fn text(j : Json) : String =
  match j of
    JStr(s) => s
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      ""

pub fn integer(j : Json) : Int =
  match j of
    JInt(n) => n
    _ => 0

pub fn truth(j : Json) : Bool =
  match j of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ => false

pub fn getfield(j : Json, key : String) : Json =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => lookup_field(xs, key)
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull

fn lookup_field(xs : List((String, Json)), key : String) : Json =
  match xs of
    Nil =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      JNull
    Cons((k, v), rest) =>
      if k == key then
        v
      else
        lookup_field(rest, key)

pub fn fields(j : Json, names : List(String)) : Unit =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) =>
      demand(length(xs) == length(names), "INVALID_INPUT")
      demand(
          all(
              \(name) -> length(filter(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == name, xs)) == 1,
              names,
            ),
          "INVALID_INPUT",
        )
    _ => reject("INVALID_INPUT")

pub fn hasfield(j : Json, key : String) : Bool =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => any(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == key, xs)
    _ => false

pub fn hasfield(j : Json, key : String) : Bool =
  match j of
    JObj(xs) => any(\(kv) -> fst(kv) == key, xs)
    _ => false

pub fn reserved(s : String) : Bool =
  elem(
      to_upper(s),
      split(
          32,
          "SELECT DISTINCT AS FROM INNER JOIN LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC NULLS FIRST LAST LIMIT OFFSET AND OR NOT IS NULL TRUE FALSE COALESCE COUNT SUM MIN MAX",
        ),
    )

pub fn letter(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c == 95

pub fn digit(c : Int) : Bool = c >= 48 && c <= 57

pub fn name_ok(s : String) : Bool =
  byte_len(s) > 0
    && letter(byte_at(s, 0))
    && all(
        \(i) -> letter(byte_at(s, i)) || digit(byte_at(s, i)),
        range(0, byte_len(s)),
      )
    && not(reserved(s))

pub fn value_type(v : Json) : String =
  match v of
    JInt(_) => "int"
    JBool(_) => "bool"
    JStr(_) => "text"
    JNull => "null"
    JFloat(_) => "invalid"
    JArr(_) => "invalid"
    JObj(_) => "invalid"

pub type Column = Column {
  name: String,
  kind: String,
  qualifier: String,
  source: Int,
  index: Int,
  nullable: Bool
}

pub type Table = Table {
  name: String,
  columns: List(Column),
  rows: List(List(Json))
}

pub type Expr = Expr {
  op: String,
  value: Json,
  qualifier: String,
  name: String,
  args: List(Expr),
  kind: String,
  index: Int,
  source: Int
}

pub fn node(op : String, args : List(Expr)) : Expr =
  Expr {
    op = op,
    value = JNull,
    qualifier = "",
    name = "",
    args = args,
    kind = "",
    index = -1,
    source = -1
  }

pub fn literal(v : Json) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("lit", []), value = v, kind = value_type(v) }

pub fn column_ref(q : String, n : String) : Expr =
  Expr { ..node("col", []), qualifier = q, name = n }

pub fn agg(op : String) : Bool = elem(op, ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX"])

pub fn at(xs : List(a), i : Int) : a =
  match nth(i, xs) of
    Some(x) => x
    None => at(xs, i)

pub type Query = Query {
  select: List((Expr, String)),
  sources: List((String, String)),
  joins: List(Expr),
  left_joins: List(Bool),
  predicate: Expr,
  groups: List(Expr),
  having: Expr,
  has_having: Bool,
  order: List((String, Int)),
  distinct: Bool,
  limit: Int,
  offset: Int
}

pub type Plan = Plan {
  query: Query,
  tables: List(Table),
  filters: List(List(Expr)),
  aggregate: Bool,
  order: List((Int, Int))
}

pub fn validate_table(j : Json) : Table =
  fields(j, ["name", "columns", "rows"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  demand(name_ok(n), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let cs = map(validate_column, arr(getfield(j, "columns")))
  demand(length(cs) > 0, "INVALID_INPUT")
  demand(unique(map(\(c) -> c.name, cs)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let rows = map(arr, arr(getfield(j, "rows")))
  for row in sof(rows) do
    demand(length(row) == length(cs), "INVALID_INPUT")
    for i in srange(0, length(cs)) do
      let v = at(row, i)
      demand(value_type(v) == at(cs, i).kind || value_type(v) == "null" && at(cs, i).nullable, "INVALID_INPUT")
  Table { name = n, columns = cs, rows = rows }

fn validate_column(j : Json) : Column =
  fields(j, ["name", "type", "nullable"])
  let n = text(getfield(j, "name"))
  let t = text(getfield(j, "type"))
  demand(name_ok(n) && elem(t, ["int", "text", "bool"]), "INVALID_INPUT")
  let nul = match getfield(j, "nullable") of
    JBool(b) => b
    _ =>
      reject("INVALID_INPUT")
      false
  Column {
    name = n,
    kind = t,
    qualifier = "",
    source = 0,
    index = 0,
    nullable = nul
  }

pub fn unique(xs : List(String)) : Bool =
  match xs of
    Nil => true
    Cons(x, rest) => not(elem(x, rest)) && unique(rest)

pub fn elem(x : a, xs : List(a)) : Bool given Eq(a) =
  match xs of
    Nil => false
    Cons(y, rest) => x == y || elem(x, rest)

fn tree_any(p : (Expr) -> Bool, e : Expr) : Bool =
  p(e) || any(\(a) -> tree_any(p, a), e.args)

defs.name: grouped
defs.source:
fn grouped(e : Expr, keys : List(Int)) : Unit =
  if not(agg(e.op)) then
    demand(e.op /= "col" || elem(e.index, keys), "INVALID_AGGREGATION")
    for a in sof(e.args) do
      grouped(a, keys)

fn alias_index(names : List(String), n : String, i : Int) : Int =
  match names of
    Nil =>
      reject("UNKNOWN_COLUMN")
      -1
    Cons(a, rest) =>
      if a == n then
        i
      else
        alias_index(rest, n, i + 1)

defs.name: compare_value
defs.source:
fn compare_value(a : Json, b : Json) : Int =
  match (a, b) of
    (JInt(x), JInt(y)) =>
      if x < y then
        -1
      elif x > y then
        1
      else
        0
    (JStr(x), JStr(y)) => str_cmp(x, y)
    (JBool(x), JBool(y)) =>
      if x == y then
        0
      elif x then
        1
      else
        -1
    _ => 0

  match es of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(e, rest) => let v = evaluate(e, row, group) in if isnull(v) then coalesce(rest, row, group) else v

defs.name: extremum
defs.source:
fn extremum(vs : List(Json), minimum : Bool) : Json =
  match vs of
    Nil => JNull
    Cons(v, Nil) => v
    Cons(JNull, rest) => extremum(rest, minimum)
    Cons(v, rest) =>
      let b = extremum(rest, minimum)
      if isnull(b) || (compare_value(v, b) < 0) == minimum then
        v
      else
        b

) : List(List(Json)) =
  match rows of

    Cons(x, rest) =>

      else
        Cons(x, insert_row(r, rest, order))

defs.name: scan_string
defs.source:
fn scan_string(s : String, i : Int, acc : String) : (String, Int) =
  demand(i < byte_len(s), "PARSE_ERROR")
  if byte_at(s, i) == 39 then
    if i + 1 < byte_len(s) && byte_at(s, i + 1) == 39 then
      scan_string(s, i + 2, concat(acc, "'"))
    else
      (acc, i + 1)
  else
    scan_string(s, i + 1, concat(acc, str_of_char(chr(byte_at(s, i)))))

defs.name: scan_word

fn scan_word(s : String, i : Int, numbers : Bool) : Int =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    i
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if (digit(c) || not(numbers) && (letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90)) then
      scan_word(s, i + 1, numbers)
    else
      i

defs.name: lex
defs.source:
fn lex(s : String, i : Int) : List(Token) =
  if i >= byte_len(s) then
    [tok("$END")]
  else
    let c = byte_at(s, i)
    if elem(c, [32, 9, 10, 13]) then
      lex(s, i + 1)
    elif c == 39 then
      let (v, j) = scan_string(s, i + 1, "")
      Cons(Token { word = "LITERAL", value = JStr(v) }, lex(s, j))
    elif digit(c) then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, true)
      let n =
        match parse_int(slice(s, i, j)) of
          Some(v) => v
          None => 0
      Cons(Token { word = "NUMBER", value = JInt(n) }, lex(s, j))
    elif letter(c) || c >= 65 && c <= 90 then
      let j = scan_word(s, i, false)
      let w = slice(s, i, j)
      Cons(tok(if reserved(w) then to_upper(w) else w), lex(s, j))
    else
      let two = slice(s, i, min(i + 2, byte_len(s)))
      if elem(two, ["<>", "<=", ">="]) then
        Cons(tok(two), lex(s, i + 2))
      else
        demand(
            elem(c, [40, 41, 44, 46, 59, 43, 45, 42, 61, 60, 62]),
            "PARSE_ERROR",
          )
        Cons(tok(str_of_char(chr(c))), lex(s, i + 1))

fn precedence(op : String) : Int =
  if op == "OR" then
    1
  elif op == "AND" then
    2
  elif elem(op, ["=", "<>", "<", ">", "<=", ">="]) then
    4
  elif elem(op, ["+", "-"]) then
    5
  elif op == "*" then
    6
  else
    0

defs.name: expression
defs.source:
fn expression(minimum : Int) : Expr =
  let t = pop()
  let w = t.word
  let e =
    if w == "NOT" then
      node(w, [expression(3)])
    elif w == "(" then
      let x = expression(1)
      expect(")")
      x
    elif w == "-" then
      literal(JInt(-natural()))
    elif elem(w, ["NUMBER", "LITERAL"]) then
      literal(t.value)
    elif elem(w, ["TRUE", "FALSE"]) then
      literal(JBool(w == "TRUE"))
    elif w == "NULL" then
      literal(JNull)
    elif w == "COALESCE" then
      expect("(")
      let first = expression(1)
      let xs = Cons(first, coalesce_tail())
      demand(length(xs) >= 2, "PARSE_ERROR")
      expect(")")
      node(w, xs)
    elif agg(w) then
      expect("(")
      let args =
        if w == "COUNT" && accept("*") then
          []
        else
          [expression(1)]
      expect(")")
      node(w, args)
    else
      demand(name_ok(w), "PARSE_ERROR")
      if accept(".") then
        column_ref(w, name())
      else
        column_ref("", w)
  binary(e, minimum, false)

defs.name: query
defs.source:
fn query() : Query =
  expect("SELECT")
  let distinct = accept("DISTINCT")
  let sels = selections()
  expect("FROM")
  let (ss, js, ls) = join_sources([source()], [], [])
  let pred =
    if accept("WHERE") then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let groups =
    if accept("GROUP") then
      expect("BY")
      group_keys()
    else
      []
  let hh = accept("HAVING")
  let hav =
    if hh then
      expression(1)
    else
      literal(JBool(true))
  let order =
    if accept("ORDER") then
      expect("BY")
      order_keys()
    else
      []
  let lim =
    if accept("LIMIT") then
      natural()
    else
      -1
  let off =
    if lim >= 0 && accept("OFFSET") then
      natural()
    else
      0
  let ignored = accept(";")
  demand(peek() == "$END", "PARSE_ERROR")
  Query {
    select = sels,
    sources = ss,
    joins = js,
    left_joins = ls,
    predicate = pred,
    groups = groups,
    having = hav,
    has_having = hh,
    order = order,
    distinct = distinct,
    limit = lim,
    offset = off
  }

    demand(value_type(getfield(c, "id")) == "int" && integer(getfield(c, "id")) > 0 && integer(getfield(c, "id")) <= 2147483647, "INVALID_COMMAND")

defs.name: command_mode
defs.source:
fn command_mode(input : Json) : Json =
  fields(input, ["database", "commands"])
  let db = map(validate_table, arr(getfield(input, "database")))
  demand(unique(map(\(t) -> t.name, db)), "INVALID_INPUT")
  var ts := map(make_live, db)
  var vs : List(View) := []
  var rev := 0
  var out := []
  let commands = arr(getfield(input, "commands"))
  demand(length(commands) <= 200, "INVALID_COMMAND")
  for c in sof(commands) do
    let (nt, nv, reply, advances) = handle command(c, db, ts, vs, rev) with
      never reject(code) => (ts, vs, error_response(code), false)
      return x => x
    ts := nt
    vs := nv
    rev := if advances then rev + 1 else rev
    out := append(out, [if op_failed(reply) then reply else JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", reply)])])
  JObj([("ok", JBool(true)), ("result", JObj([("results", JArr(out))]))])
